name: komga
description: Self-hosted comics, manga, and ebook server with a browser-based reader

fields.name: KOMGA_PORT
fields.label: R1: App Port
fields.help: Host port used to open Komga in your browser.

fields.name: KOMGA_CONFIG_LOCATION
fields.label: R2: Config Folder
fields.help: Stores Komga configuration, database files, logs, and application state.

fields.name: KOMGA_COMICS_LOCATION
fields.label: R3: Comics Folder
fields.help: Folder containing the comics, manga, and ebook library to scan in Komga.

fields.name: PUID
fields.label: R4: PUID
fields.help: User ID used by Komga for file permissions. This becomes the first part of the Compose user value.

fields.name: PGID
fields.label: R5: PGID
fields.help: Group ID used by Komga for file permissions. This becomes the second part of the Compose user value.

fields.name: TZ
fields.label: O1: Timezone
fields.help:
Timezone used by Komga logs and scheduled tasks.
Example: Asia/Dubai.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O2: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: KOMGA_NETWORK_MODE
fields.label: A1: Network
fields.help: Choose the default bridge network, host networking, or an existing Docker network.

fields.name: KOMGA_IMAGE
fields.label: A2: Image
fields.help:
Docker image used for Komga.
Change this only if you want a different tag or image source.

fields.name: KOMGA_PORT_MAPPING
fields.label: Bridge Port Mapping
fields.help: Port mapping used when Komga is not running in host mode.

fields.name: KOMGA_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: Recipe-managed container name from the source Compose example.

ui.overview: Komga is a self-hosted comics, manga, and ebook server with library management and a browser-based reader.
what_happens: A Komga container will be created
The web interface will be published on the port you choose
Your config folder and comics library folder will be mounted into the container
Komga will run as the PUID and PGID you provide
Bridge networking is used by default, with optional host or existing-network choices under Advanced
ui.data_location: Relative paths are stored inside this app's project folder under the mounted EasyDocker base config path.
